body.x: Haier participated in ‘CES 2018(Consumer Technology Show)’, the world’s largest IT consumer electronics show held in Las Vegas, the U.S.A. from Tues. 9th to Fri. 12th in Jan. and introduced an eco-friendly smart home system.

The smart home system realized by interconnection and linkage of all home appliances rather than controlling home appliances through only existing smartphone, makes users’ lives comfortable in every part of house including living room, kitchen, bathroom and bedroom. The smart home includes a heater that uses low-carbon energy, and a washing machine that saves energy by fast washing.

CES, the world’s largest IT exhibition, is an exhibition of trends in the global consumer electronics industry, held annually in January by the American Consumer Technology Association (CTA). Aving News reported the most issues of CES, MWC, and IFA, which are world's top three tech exhibitions, during last 11 years. It is sending special reporters to CES for this year as well; reporting major issues in the world market and introduce Korea's major companies all over the world.
